title: Sniper Elite 5
summary: World War II stealth-action shooter centered on long-range sniping, large infiltration maps and flexible objectives, with co-op and more direct combat options alongside the sniper systems.

observations.statement: Reviews support the large-map infiltration structure and broad freedom to approach objectives with stealth, sniping or more direct action.
Some veteran feedback describes the game as leaning more toward general commando-style action and making sniping easier than earlier entries.
At least one reviewed comparison found the campaign's later levels and story less compelling than its stronger opening missions.

conflicts.statement: Players can value the broader, more flexible action sandbox while series veterans may prefer the tighter sniping emphasis of earlier entries.

steam_reviews.query: Steam Community review pages; Russian and non-Russian lanes attempted; accessible index was sparse
